source: S12: Patton (2011), Journal of Econometrics 160, 246-256, Table 1, journal p250 / downloaded PDF p5
target: All 9 loss-function rows and the nu=6, nu=10, Normal columns; sigma squared=1
design: Analytical and numerical integration reproduction; no fitted or simulated market data
reason_for_tolerance: Source rounds to 2 decimal places; MAE-prop source is an explicit numerical approximation
independent_check: Quadrature of standardized return densities for E|r|, E log(r^2), E r^4 and size-biased median; compare closed forms
not_claimed: This is a foundational noisy-proxy loss replication, not a replication of a roughness estimator or market forecast contest
